changelog:
Stop on your television now appears whenever it should.

WHAT CHANGED

- When the app reconnects to your paired PerchTV television, for
  example after the phone wakes up or the app is reopened, it now asks
  the television what it is doing. So "Stop on" your television appears
  as soon as the television is playing something, and disappears when
  it stops, without waiting for anything to change on the television.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else, including sending to the television, stopping from
  the phone, the LIVE button, and recovery from dropped streams.
